_doc: The new v0.2 faction creatures that Pulp Wars has no sprite for (docs/design/FACTION_*.md section 10): Squire, Friar and Dragonslayer (the Realm), the Late King (the Restless) and the Boomshaman (the Goblin Horde). Layers follow Pulp Wars (LESSONS section 5.2) and the lost-world-hero set: style, camera, light, class, subject. No faction layer (the 2000-character cap); each subject carries the colours of the Pulp Wars sprites it stands beside: Realm crimson and gold-yellow heraldry with light steel (HERALDIC), Restless ivory bone, near-black cloth and one violet accent (BONE), Horde lime skin, sand-buff hide, tin and hazard yellow (LIME); the Candy Kingdom (bead border_marches-bzc.112, FACTION_CANDY.md 10.1) gingerbread #b86b34, royal icing #fff4ec, strawberry frosting #e2589b, candy-cane red #e03a3e, mint #7fd6b5 and sugar glass #8fe3e8, with Sugarplum purple on the Sugarplum only (CANDY); the Deepforge (bead border_marches-bzc.131, FACTION_DWARVES.md 10.1) polished brass #d9a634, copper #c7683a, verdigris #3aa38f, iron #4a4f57, steam white #f4f1ea and ginger or grey beards, white steam and never black smoke, machines with porthole-eye faces; machines without feet (the Gyrocopter, the Steam Tank, the Ironclad) drop the class layer and name the outline, as rock-candy-dragon-b; creatures that hold nothing (the Gummy Bear, the Rock Candy Dragon) take the strays' creature class layer (@creature). Faces south-east; never mirrored. A smaller unit is generated at a smaller request and padded bottom-centred into its class canvas. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: Squire, a chunky cute young squire boy with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny body: a friendly freckled face with big eyes, messy straw-blond hair under a small round light steel cap, a bright crimson tunic with a gold-yellow cross, cream sleeves, dark slate-grey boots, a short light steel sword in the right hand and a huge crimson kite shield with a gold-yellow cross on the left arm, far too big for him, reaching from his chin to his ankles; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a small eager boy, not a grown soldier.
recipes.negative: visor, beard, horse, bow, brown leather

recipes.subject: Subject: Late King, a chunky cute skeleton king seated on a royal litter carried by two small skeleton bearers, filling the whole width of the image: the king has a huge round pale ivory skull with glowing bright violet eye sockets and a wide-open mouth mid-proclamation, a big tarnished bronze crown, a near-black royal cape with a white ermine collar and thin bright violet trim, one bony arm raised grandly and a cream scroll in the other hand; the litter is a near-black wooden seat on two long poles resting on the bearers' shoulders; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: red cloth, green skin, blood, gore, horse, throne room

recipes.subject: Subject: Boomshaman, a chunky cute goblin storm shaman with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a small body, head and ears filling the whole width: bright lime green skin #86c232 with a lighter #acdc55 face and darker #5a9424 shading, huge pointed ears, a manic grin, frizzled white hair standing on end, a pale sand-buff patched hide robe, a tall crooked tin lightning rod with a hazard yellow #fdd20f spiral and a crackling pale yellow spark held up high in the right hand, small black bombs on the belt, bare lime green feet; simple shapes; clearly a reckless spellcaster.
recipes.negative: purple glow, red cloth, skull, gun

recipes.subject: Subject: Late King, a chunky cute skeleton king seated on a royal litter on the shoulders of two small skeleton bearers, one in front and one behind, filling the whole width of the image: the king has a huge round pale ivory skull with glowing bright violet eye sockets and a wide-open mouth mid-proclamation, a big tarnished bronze crown, a near-black royal cape with a white ermine collar and thin bright violet trim, one bony arm raised grandly holding a cream scroll; the litter is a near-black wooden chair on two long poles; the bearers are pale ivory skeletons; simple shapes.
recipes.negative: wheels, cart, animals, red cloth, green skin, blood, gore, horse
recipes.notes: late-king-a drew a wheeled cart pulled by two black beasts, not a litter: bearers named as ivory skeletons, wheels and animals excluded.

recipes.subject: Subject: Boomshaman, a chunky cute goblin storm shaman with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a small body, head and ears filling the whole width: bright lime green skin #86c232 like a fresh lime, not olive, lighter #acdc55 face, huge pointed ears, a manic grin, frizzled white hair standing on end, a pale sand-buff patched hide robe, a tall crooked light grey tin lightning rod with a hazard yellow #fdd20f zigzag bolt crackling at its tip held up high in the right hand, small black bombs on the belt, bare lime green feet standing on nothing; simple shapes.
recipes.negative: dirt, ground patch, fire, torch, purple glow, red cloth, skull, gun
recipes.notes: boomshaman-a stood on a soil patch, skin olive and the rod read as a torch: lime named against olive, the bolt as a zigzag, dirt and torch excluded.

recipes.subject: Subject: Friar, a chunky cute jolly round friar with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a plump sturdy body: a bald tonsured head with a ring of straw-blond hair, rosy cheeks and a big kind smile, a long plain cream-white wool habit down to the feet with a bright crimson rope belt and a small gold-yellow cross pendant, a long pale yellow birch quarterstaff held upright in the right hand, the left hand raised in blessing with a few small gold-yellow sparkles, dark slate-grey sandals; clearly a healer monk, not a soldier; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: armour, helmet, shield, sword, brown robe, brown leather

recipes.subject: Subject: Dragonslayer, one very large chunky cute champion knight, the biggest and heaviest of the kingdom, filling the whole width of the image: a huge round head in a closed light steel great helm with a gold-yellow crown band and a big crimson plume, massive rounded light steel plate armour with gold-yellow rims, a crimson surcoat with a gold-yellow cross, an enormous light steel greatsword held upright, and a big stuffed green dragon head with cream horns and a lolling tongue strapped on his back as a trophy, peeking over his shoulder; dark slate-grey boots; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: horse, shield, skull, brown leather, blood

recipes.subject: Subject: Orc Warboss, one very large chunky cute orc war chief, the biggest of the horde, filling the whole width of the image: a huge round head with bright lime green skin #86c232 and a lighter #acdc55 face, a big open shouting grin with two cream tusks, a dented light grey steel viking helmet with two big curved cream horns, a huge shaggy pale sand-buff fur mantle over broad bare lime green shoulders, a big iron belt buckle, a hazard yellow #fdd20f loincloth, chunky dark brown boots, one big fist clenched and the other holding up a big brass war horn; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: boar, wolf, red cloth, skull, gun, axe, olive skin
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.29: a giant (tier 6) take after the imported 56x80 Pulp Wars warboss (goblin-orc-warboss), keeping its design: horned steel helmet, fur mantle, war horn, yellow loincloth.

recipes.subject: Subject: Gingerbread Man, a small chunky cute living gingerbread cookie soldier with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a short stubby cookie body: warm gingerbread brown #b86b34 with darker #7d4420 shading, a happy face piped in white royal icing #fff4ec with two round eyes and a wide smile, wavy white icing piping around the wrists and ankles, three round gumdrop buttons down the front in red, mint green and pink, a small red #e03a3e and white striped candy-cane spear held upright in the right hand, stubby rounded cookie arms and legs; simple shapes; clearly a cookie, not a person.
recipes.negative: clothes, hat, armour, shield, crumbs
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.112: tier 1 of the Candy Kingdom, generated small like the Squire and padded into 56x80.

recipes.subject: Subject: Taffy Wrangler, a chunky cute stretchy cowpoke made of glossy strawberry pink pulled taffy #e2589b with darker #a8336c shading, with a huge round head about half of the figure's height: big round eyes and a cheeky grin, a wide-brimmed toffee brown #b86b34 cowboy hat, a white icing #fff4ec neckerchief, rubbery stretchy arms, the right arm raised high swinging a big looping lasso of pink and white striped pulled taffy over its head, short stubby legs with little toffee brown boots; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: horse, gun, hemp rope, brown skin
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.112: tier 3 of the Candy Kingdom (Reel In).

recipes.subject: Subject: Rock Candy Dragon, one very large chunky cute dragon of rock candy crystals, filling the whole width of the image: a big round head with big friendly eyes and a toothy smile, a chunky body of faceted sugar-glass teal #8fe3e8 crystals with #4fa9b3 shading and strawberry pink #e2589b facets, pink crystal spikes down its back, two big pale teal sugar-glass wings spread wide, a stubby tail with a crystal tip, four short sturdy legs; solid opaque colours.
recipes.negative: rider, fire, rocks
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.112: tier 6 (giant) of the Candy Kingdom (Afters).

recipes.subject: Subject: Taffy Wrangler, a chunky cute candy creature made entirely of glossy strawberry pink pulled taffy #e2589b with darker #a8336c shading, a soft stretchy candy person: a huge smooth round taffy head about half of the figure's height with a simple happy face, two dot eyes and a wide grin, no nose and no snout, a wide-brimmed toffee brown #b86b34 cowboy hat, a white icing #fff4ec neckerchief, long rubbery stretchy pink arms, the right arm raised high swinging a big lasso loop of pink and white striped taffy, short stubby pink legs; nothing worn but the hat and neckerchief; simple shapes.
recipes.negative: pig, cow, snout, horse, gun, shirt, trousers
recipes.notes: taffy-wrangler-a drew a pig cowpoke in brown clothes: the body named as taffy with no snout, clothes excluded.

recipes.subject: Subject: Rock Candy Dragon, one very large chunky cute dragon built of rock candy, filling the whole width of the image, thick single-colour black outline, its head and body turned down and to the right, snout pointing to the bottom right: a big blocky head with big friendly eyes and a toothy smile, a body of big angular crystal chunks like rock candy on a stick, sharp flat facets each with one light and one shadow side, sugar-glass teal #8fe3e8 crystals shaded #4fa9b3 and strawberry pink #e2589b crystals shaded #a8336c, jagged pink crystal spikes down its back, two big pale teal faceted sugar-glass wings spread wide, four short sturdy legs, all four feet visible and lowest in the image; solid opaque colours; simple shapes.
recipes.negative: rider, fire, rocks, smooth scales, pedestal, ground plate, platform, scenery, background, shadow on the ground
recipes.notes: rock-candy-dragon-a faced south-west and had smooth scales: the creature layer (rounded rubbery shapes) dropped for an explicit outline, the facets and the south-east facing named.

recipes.subject: Remove all ground: erase the round patch of green grass and brown soil under the figure's feet, leaving that area transparent, so the figure stands on a transparent background with nothing at all under it. Keep the pink taffy figure, its cowboy hat, neckerchief and striped lasso, its colours, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: Ground-removal edit of taffy-wrangler-b#0.

recipes.subject: Subject: Peppermint Archer, a chunky cute candy kid archer with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a small body: a rosy smiling face with big eyes, a big round hood swirled candy-cane red #e03a3e and icing white #fff4ec like a peppermint candy, a short mint green #7fd6b5 tunic with #3f9a7c shading, a big red and white striped candy-cane bow held in the left hand with an arrow nocked, a quiver of candy-stick arrows on the back, white leggings and little red boots; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: crossbow, green hood, sword, shield, cape
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.112: tier 2 of the Candy Kingdom (Sitting Ducks).

recipes.subject: Subject: Sugarplum, a plump chunky cute sugarplum fairy hovering in the air, with a huge round head about half of her height: a round plum purple #8e3fa0 body like a sugared plum dusted with white sugar sparkles, darker #5e2470 shading, a big friendly face with rosy cheeks, a little green plum stem and leaf on top of her head, two small lacy wings of white spun sugar, a lollipop wand with a pink and white swirl held up in the right hand with a few tiny pink sparkles, tiny stubby legs dangling; she floats with nothing under her and her feet are the lowest thing in the image; simple shapes.
recipes.negative: skull, ghost, scary, witch hat, broom
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.112: tier 4 of the Candy Kingdom (the caster). Purple on the Sugarplum only (FACTION_CANDY 10.1).

recipes.subject: Subject: Gummy Bear, a huge chunky cute gummy bear sweet come to life, filling the whole width of the image: a big round head with small round ears, big round eyes and a wide friendly grin, a plump glossy strawberry red #e03a3e jelly body with darker #9c2229 shading and a few white shine highlights, a light crust of white sugar crystals on its head and shoulders, short stubby arms and legs, standing upright like a candy gummy bear; solid opaque colours.
recipes.negative: fur, teddy bear, clothes
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.112: tier 5 (large) of the Candy Kingdom (Chewy).

recipes.subject: Remove all ground: erase the floating block of green grass and brown soil under the fairy, leaving that area transparent, so the fairy hovers on a transparent background with nothing at all under her. Keep the purple plum fairy, her leaf, wings and lollipop wand, her colours, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: Ground-removal edit of sugarplum-a#0.

recipes.subject: Subject: Sugarplum, a big plump chunky cute sugarplum fairy hovering in the air, filling the whole width of the image: a huge round plum purple #8e3fa0 body like a sugared plum dusted with white sugar sparkles, darker #5e2470 shading, a big friendly face with rosy cheeks, a little green plum stem and leaf on top, two lacy wings of white spun sugar, a lollipop wand with a pink and white swirl held up in the right hand, tiny stubby legs dangling; she floats with nothing at all under her and her feet are the lowest thing in the image; simple shapes.
recipes.negative: grass block, ground tile, floating island, skull, ghost, witch hat, broom
recipes.notes: sugarplum-a-clean is right but reads smaller than the tier 1 Gingerbread Man on the battle line-up: the same design asked to fill the canvas width, ground blocks excluded.

recipes.subject: Subject: Sugarplum, a big round plump chunky cute sugarplum fairy, as wide as the image and nearly as tall: a huge round plum purple #8e3fa0 head and a fat round plum body dusted with white sugar sparkles, darker #5e2470 shading, a big friendly face with rosy cheeks, a green plum stem and leaf on top, two big lacy wings of white spun sugar spread wide to both sides, a big lollipop wand with a pink and white swirl held up in the right hand, short stubby legs; she hovers with nothing at all under her and her feet are the lowest thing in the image; simple shapes.
recipes.negative: grass block, ground tile, floating island, skull, ghost, witch hat, thin, slender
recipes.notes: Coordinator review: the tier 4 caster should have about the Taffy Wrangler's visual mass; plumper body and wings spread wide to fill the 56x80 canvas.

recipes.subject: Subject: Sugarplum, a big round plump chunky cute sugarplum fairy, as wide as the image and nearly as tall: a huge round plum purple #8e3fa0 head and a fat round plum body dusted with white sugar sparkles, darker #5e2470 shading, a big friendly face with rosy cheeks, a green plum stem and leaf on top, two big lacy wings of white spun sugar spread wide to both sides, a big lollipop wand with a pink and white swirl held up in the right hand, short stubby legs; she hovers with nothing at all under her and her feet are the lowest thing in the image; simple shapes.

recipes.notes: Second seed of sugarplum-c.

recipes.subject: Subject: Tinker, a small stout chunky cute dwarf tinker woman with a huge round head about half of the figure's height: a rosy smiling face, big polished brass #d9a634 goggles pushed up on a small verdigris #3aa38f cap, a big ginger #c0562a braided beard tied with brass rings, a white #f4f1ea shirt under a brown leather apron, a tiny round copper #c7683a boiler strapped on her back puffing one small white steam cloud, an oversized brass wrench held over her shoulder in the right hand, short stubby legs with iron grey #4a4f57 boots; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: gun, axe, sword, horned helmet, black smoke, fire
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.131: tier 1 of the Deepforge (Patch Up), generated small like the Gingerbread Man and padded into 56x80.

recipes.subject: Subject: Mortar, a squat chunky cute clockwork mortar automaton standing on two short stubby iron #4a4f57 legs: a big round riveted polished brass #d9a634 body with #9a6f1c shading and verdigris #3aa38f trim bands, a friendly face on its front with two big round glass porthole eyes and a small grille mouth, a fat short copper #c7683a cannon barrel on its top pointing straight up at the sky with a little white #f4f1ea steam puff at its rim, a big brass wind-up key on its back; a machine, nobody rides it; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: dwarf, person, rider, wheels, black smoke, fire, explosion
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.131: tier 4 of the Deepforge (Lob), a squat walking gun at the standard canvas.

recipes.subject: Subject: Steam Tank, one chunky cute little steam tank machine filling the whole width of the image, thick single-colour black outline, facing down and to the right: a chubby round riveted body of verdigris #3aa38f plates with #226b5d shading and polished brass #d9a634 trim and rivets, two big round glass porthole eyes and a smiling grille mouth on its front, a heavy brass battering-ram nose pointing to the bottom right, a tall copper #c7683a chimney on top puffing a big white #f4f1ea steam cloud, chunky iron #4a4f57 caterpillar tracks along both sides, the tracks the lowest thing in the image; a machine, nobody rides it; solid opaque colours; simple shapes.
recipes.negative: gun, cannon, turret, person, rider, black smoke, fire, pedestal, ground plate, platform, scenery, background, shadow on the ground
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.131: tier 5 (large) of the Deepforge (Ram). No class layer: a machine on tracks, not a figure with feet.

recipes.subject: Subject: Tinker, a small stout chunky cute dwarf tinker woman with a huge round head about half of the figure's height: a rosy smiling face, big brass #d9a634 goggles pushed up on a small verdigris #3aa38f cap, a big ginger #c0562a braided beard tied with brass rings, a white #f4f1ea shirt under a brown leather apron, a tiny copper #c7683a boiler on her back puffing a small white steam cloud, a huge shiny brass wrench as long as her body held diagonally across her front in both hands, short stubby legs with iron grey #4a4f57 boots; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: gun, axe, sword, hammer, horned helmet, black smoke, fire
recipes.notes: tinker-a reads well but its wrench is a small stub behind the shoulder: the signature tool asked for as long as her body, held across the front.

recipes.subject: Replace the open cannon barrel at the front of the tank with a solid battering ram: a short thick closed brass log ending in a flat round brass ram head with a ring of rivets, no hole and no opening at its end. Keep everything else exactly the same: the green riveted body, the porthole eyes, the copper chimney and its white steam cloud, the tracks, the colours, the thick black outline and the art style.
recipes.notes: steam-tank-a is right except its ram nose is an open gun barrel (reads as a cannon; the Steam Tank rams, it does not shoot): one-part edit.

recipes.subject: Subject: Rivet Gunner, a chunky cute dwarf gunner with a huge round head about half of the figure's height: a cheerful face, a bushy grey #b8b2a6 beard braided with brass rings, a round verdigris #3aa38f helmet with a brass rim and brass #d9a634 goggles, a brown leather coat, a big chunky polished brass rivet gun with a fat drum held in both hands and pointing to the right, a thick iron grey hose from the gun to a round copper #c7683a tank on his back, short stubby legs with iron grey #4a4f57 boots; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: musket, rifle, bow, sword, axe, horned helmet, black smoke, fire
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.131: tier 2 of the Deepforge (Hot Rivets), the shooter; grey beard and a verdigris helmet to tell him from the ginger Tinker.

recipes.subject: Subject: Gyrocopter, one chunky cute little round flying machine hovering in the air, filling the whole width of the image, thick single-colour black outline, facing down and to the right: a round polished brass #d9a634 pod with #9a6f1c shading and verdigris #3aa38f trim, a wide two-bladed iron #4a4f57 rotor on a short mast on top, two stubby little wings, a small tail fan, a cheerful dwarf pilot with brass goggles, a ginger #c0562a beard and a long white #f4f1ea scarf sitting in the open cockpit, a small white steam puff from an exhaust pipe; it hovers with nothing at all under it and its lowest part is the lowest thing in the image; solid opaque colours; simple shapes.
recipes.negative: gun, bomb, black smoke, fire, grass block, floating island, ground tile, pedestal, platform, scenery, background, shadow on the ground
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.131: tier 3 of the Deepforge (Rotors, Spotter), the flier. At the standard canvas, like every Candy tier 1-4, so the sizes rise with tier (FACTION_DWARVES 10.2 had 72x88: orchestrator's size-by-tier rule).

recipes.subject: Subject: Ironclad, one very large chunky cute walking iron fortress machine, filling the whole width of the image, thick single-colour black outline, facing down and to the right: a squat round riveted hull of iron #4a4f57 with #2e3238 shading and big verdigris #3aa38f armour plates, polished brass #d9a634 trim and rivets, two big round glass porthole eyes on its front, a round brass gun turret on top with one short fat cannon barrel pointing to the bottom right, twin copper #c7683a smokestacks puffing white #f4f1ea steam, four short stubby iron legs, all four feet visible and lowest in the image; a machine, nobody rides it; solid opaque colours; simple shapes.
recipes.negative: person, rider, tracks, wheels, black smoke, fire, pedestal, ground plate, platform, scenery, background, shadow on the ground
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.131: tier 6 (giant) of the Deepforge (Turret).

recipes.subject: Remove all ground: erase the square block of green grass and brown soil under the dwarf's feet, leaving that area transparent, so the dwarf stands on a transparent background with nothing at all under her boots. Keep the dwarf, her verdigris cap and goggles, ginger beard, apron, boiler and big brass wrench, her colours, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: Ground-removal edit of tinker-b#0 (the wrench is right; it stands on a grass block).

recipes.subject: Subject: Gyrocopter, one big chunky cute round flying machine hovering in the air, as wide as the image and filling most of its height, thick single-colour black outline, facing down and to the right: a big fat round polished brass #d9a634 pod with #9a6f1c shading and verdigris #3aa38f trim bands, a two-bladed iron #4a4f57 rotor as wide as the image on a short mast on top, two stubby wings, a small tail fan, a cheerful dwarf pilot with brass goggles, a ginger #c0562a beard and a long white #f4f1ea scarf in the open cockpit, a small white steam puff from an exhaust pipe; it hovers with nothing at all under it; solid opaque colours; simple shapes.
